propositions: The tutorial currently downloads the Gerrit hook directly and must be corrected to use the supported `make hooks` command instead.
The tutorial permits small patches to bypass Gerrit but current policy requires every change to main to pass through Gerrit.
The tutorial recommends `recheck` for suspected flaky failures but policy requires root-cause investigation of nondeterministic tests via the /rebar-debug workflow.
Maintainer sponsorship must be described as assistance without permitting a Gerrit review bypass.

Test contracts must assert the presence of corrected guidance (make hooks, Gerrit passage, sponsorship without bypass, environmental-only recheck, rebar-debug workflow) and reject superseded instructions (direct curl download, Gerrit bypass language, suspected-flake retry guidance).
